question: A confidence interval to estimate the population mean will be more precise when:

options.opb: The greater the dispersion of the sample.
options.opd: The greater the level of trust.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: The smaller the sample size -> The confidence interval will be more precise -> 80% CHAIN: The greater the dispersion of the sample -> The confidence interval will be less precise -> 70% CHAIN: The lower the confidence level -> The confidence interval will be more precise -> 90% CHAIN: The greater the level of trust -> No direct impact on the precision of the confidence interval -> 80%
